column5: Next question: what is the capital city of Australia? Check the answer to 'Sydney' and give the correct one if wrong.
Kid practice: '7 times 8'. Check the answer to '54' and, if wrong, explain the correct product briefly.
Make 8 Spanish flashcards for beginner food vocabulary, each with the Spanish word on the front and the English translation on the back, ready to flip.
Write 6 flashcards on European capitals where the front is the country and the back is the capital, and note which ones I should mark as missed if I mix up similar names.
Give a short, clear explanation of how to play a number guessing game where one player thinks of a number from 1 to 100 and the others take turns guessing with higher or lower hints.
Explain the rules of rock paper scissors, including how each turn works, what beats what, and how a tie is handled, in simple words for a beginner.
Calculate my weighted grade: homework is 40% and I have 88, quizzes are 20% and I have 75, and the final is 40% with an unknown score. What do I need on the final to get at least 85 overall?
Find my GPA from these courses: Biology 3 credits with a B, Calculus 4 credits with a C, English 2 credits with an A, and History 3 credits with a B+. Use standard 4.0 scale.
How many days are there between March 3, 2026 and July 19, 2026?
If I was born on September 14, 1987, how many days old am I on February 20, 2026?
Give a pep talk for someone on a 12-day no-sugar streak whose longest streak is 21 days.
Write a short encouraging note for someone on a 5-day meditation streak who just hit their longest streak of 5 days.
I finished day 12 of the 30-day plank challenge, holding 90 seconds today. Write a short encouraging check-in message for me.
I'm on day 8 of a 30-day pushup challenge and only managed 12 pushups today, fewer than yesterday. Write a brief motivating note to keep me going.
Give this blood pressure reading a category and a one-line explanation: 138 over 88.
Categorize this BMI and add a short note on what it means: 27.4 for an adult.
From my contacts list, show only the ones whose names start with 'Mar' — I typed that in the filter box and need them listed out with phone numbers.
Filter my books shelf to only the unread ones, then give me a short list of titles I could start this weekend.
Suggest a hangman word for a food-themed round: six letters, no repeats, common enough for casual players.
Give a scrambled word game answer: unscramble the letters TAPNELE to form a common six-letter word and hint at its meaning.
The user typed: 'Hello world! This is a test.' Give a word count, character count with spaces, and character count without spaces.
Rate the strength of the password 'Passw0rd2024' as weak, medium, or strong, and list two specific ways to make it stronger.
Turn this Morse code into plain text: -.-. .- .. .--. .... . .-. ...
Convert the Roman numeral MCMXCIV into a number, and give the result in one short sentence.
Write a short, upbeat message for the dice roller's history panel after I just rolled a double six, mentioning the roll and that it was my third double in a row.
Give me a quick summary line for the coin flip streak stats screen showing that I've flipped heads five times in a row, with a playful nudge to keep going.
Pick 3 students without repeats from our class list: Maya, Leo, Priya, Sam, Jonah, Elena, Marcus, Tessa.
Draw 5 lottery numbers without repeats between 1 and 50 for tonight's office pool.

The roommates listed for the bathroom deep-clean rotation are Maya, Dev, and Priya, in that order, with Maya last completed. Tell us whose turn is next and give a one-line reminder message to send them.
Our dishwashing turns go Sam, then Lena, then Theo, and Sam just finished tonight. Say who washes tomorrow and add a short friendly nudge for that person.
Explain how the Stableford scoring system works for a beginner golfer who has just finished a round. Cover points for birdie, par, bogey, double bogey, and worse.
In tennis, the score is 30-40 with the server behind. Explain the possible next scores including deuce, advantage, and game, and what the players need to do.
I borrowed $12,000 at 6.5% annual interest to be repaid over 36 months. Show me the month-by-month schedule of remaining balance and interest paid.
I put $5,000 into a savings account at 4% interest compounded yearly, adding nothing more. Show me the balance at the end of each year for 10 years.
A snake plant was last watered on March 4 and needs water every 14 days. What is the next watering date?
A medication was last taken at 8:30 AM and is due every 6 hours. What is the next dose time?
It has been 6 hours since my last coffee. Suggest a gentle way to ease the withdrawal headache and stay alert for the rest of the workday.
It has been 4 hours since the baby's last feeding, and she is starting to fuss. Give me a quick checklist to decide whether to feed now or wait a bit longer.
My mood journal shows entries from the last month: Mondays 6, Tuesdays 7, Wednesdays 5, Thursdays 8, Fridays 9, Saturdays 9, Sundays 4. Summarize my average mood by weekday.
My sleep log for the past three weeks: week 1 averaged 6.5 hours, week 2 averaged 7.2 hours, week 3 averaged 5.8 hours. Summarize my weekly average sleep trend.
Suggest a fair way to split the $1,800 rent among 3 roommates: Ana has the 200 sq ft room, Ben the 150 sq ft room, and Cy the 100 sq ft room with no window.
Split a $140 dinner bill where Mia had the $32 steak, Leo had the $18 pasta and two $9 cocktails, and Sam only had a $14 salad and water.
Suggest three memory card matching game themes for kids using animals, vehicles, and food cards.
Create a Simon Says color sequence game with four colors and increasing difficulty levels for players.
Give me a short pep talk before my 60-second typing speed test: I average 48 WPM but keep freezing on punctuation.
Suggest a quick warm-up plan for a math facts speed drill where I solve 40 multiplication problems in two minutes and keep missing the 7s.
Add a study plan to my calendar: math revision 7-8pm on weekdays, physics 6-7pm on Saturdays, and a practice test every Sunday 10am-12pm for the next four weeks.
Create birthday reminders in my calendar for Mom on March 14, Jake on April 2, and Priya on May 21, each with an alert one week before and on the day.
Create a gentle wake-up alarm for 6:45 a.m. on weekdays that detects lighter sleep phases within 30 minutes before the alarm and uses soft nature sounds that slowly increase in volume.
Set a daily medicine reminder called 'Blood pressure pill' at 8:00 a.m. and 8:00 p.m., with a full-screen alert that stays until I tap 'Taken' and a snooze option of 10 minutes.
Make an SOS signal with the flashlight: three short flashes, three long, three short. Give me the timing in seconds for each flash and the gap between them.
Spell "HELP" in Morse code using the phone flashlight. List each letter's dots and dashes with a short flash or long flash and the pauses between letters.
Write a short text to my boss saying I'm running about 15 minutes late because of a delayed train, apologizing and saying I'll be there as soon as I can.
Write a message to my partner sharing our shopping list: milk, eggs, bread, bananas, chicken, and dishwasher tablets, asking them to grab it all on the way home.
Suggest a quick-dial label for a call to Mom, and a short reason to keep her at the top of the list.
From today's call-back list (dentist, plumber, school office), suggest which call to make first and a one-line reminder of what to say.
Walking from 14 Baker Street to the nearest pharmacy, list the pharmacy name and turn-by-turn directions in short steps.
I opened three trip stops in maps for a day out: Camden Market, Regent's Park, British Museum. Suggest a walking order and how long to spend at each.
Suggest a bedtime mode schedule that fits my usual sleep and wake times: bed at 11:15pm, alarm at 7:00am, and phone charging on the nightstand.
Explain in simple steps how to turn off Wi-Fi and Bluetooth together from the control center so my phone stops searching for networks and devices.
Create a gentle vibration pattern for a phone metronome at 80 BPM, using a soft pulse on each beat, so the user can feel the tempo without sound.
Design a posture reminder that gives one short vibration when the user slouches for more than 30 seconds, and a double vibration when posture is corrected.
Suggest a wind-down sound mix using these entries: white noise, rain, distant thunder, soft piano, with a 30-minute sleep timer.
Give me countdown beeps for a 5K race start using these entries: 3 short beeps, 1 long beep, 10-second gap, then go tone.
Write a two-sentence photo-of-the-day journal entry about a photo of a dog asleep on a sunny windowsill.
Write a short voice memo titled "Grocery run" reminding me to buy milk, eggs, and bread, with one extra note about picking up the dry cleaning.
Eight-team knockout bracket, results so far: A beat B 2-1, C beat D 3-0, E beat F 1-0, G beat H 2-2 on penalties. Who advances to the semifinals and who plays whom?
Round robin table for my five-a-side league after week 3: Reds 7 pts, Blues 6, Greens 5, Whites 3, Yellows 1. Which teams can still win the title?
Assign 24 wedding guests to 4 tables of 6, keeping the bride's family together, separating the two feuding aunts, and placing grandparents near the exit.
Shuffle 30 students into 5 rows of 6 for a fresh seating chart, keeping talkative pairs apart and putting students who need front-row access in the first two rows.
Build a week of dinners for a family of four using chicken thighs, broccoli, sweet potatoes, and pasta, plus a shopping list for anything missing.
Plan five lunchboxes for a school week from these entries: hummus, carrots, crackers, grapes, cheddar, tortillas, and yogurt, and list what to buy.
Make a packing list for a 5-day beach trip with carry-on only, using these choices: 3 swimsuits, 4 t-shirts, 1 pair sandals, 1 light jacket, sunscreen, sunglasses, phone charger.
Build a camping checklist for a rainy weekend using what I entered: tent, rainfly, tarp, 2 sleeping bags, camp stove, waterproof matches, 2 pairs wool socks, ponchos, cooler.
Suggest a reward for my son who earned 45 chore points this week: he did dishes, took out trash, and fed the dog daily.
My daughter has 300 reading points from finishing six books; suggest two prizes she can unlock, like a bookstore gift card or a movie night.

My envelope budget has $240 left in groceries and $85 in dining out, and I want to move $50 from dining to groceries for the rest of the month. Suggest how to make that transfer and what it means for each pot.
I have savings pots for a vacation ($1,200), a new laptop ($600), and an emergency fund ($2,000), and I can set aside $300 this month. Suggest how to split the $300 across the three pots.
Build me a random workout from my exercises: squats, push-ups, dumbbell rows, lunges, plank. Keep it under 30 minutes.
Generate a core routine using planks, crunches, leg raises, and Russian twists for 12 minutes, with sets and rest times.
Create a Spanish verb conjugation drill for the verb 'tener' in the present tense, with 6 fill-in-the-blank sentences and an answer key.
Make an English irregular verbs practice set using 'go', 'see', and 'take', with 6 past-tense fill-in sentences and answers.
Using pantry stock with low alerts: oats at 1 cup left over 2, peanut butter at 2 tbsp left over 3, honey at 1 tsp left over 2. Suggest a breakfast bowl using what's about to run out.

Using the office supplies reorder list: printer paper down to 1 ream with a 5-ream threshold, blue pens at 2 with a 10-pen threshold, sticky notes at 1 pad with a 4-pad threshold. Draft a short reorder request to the office manager.

Compare three apartments by score: A is $1,400 near downtown, B is $1,150 with a 30-minute commute, C is $1,300 with a gym and parking. Weigh rent, location, and amenities.

Which weekday is December 25, 2030, and was 1900 a leap year?

List which warranties are about to end from these: laptop (ends in 5 days), printer (ends in 12 days), fridge (ends in 30 days). Remind me what to do about the most urgent one.

I have two paint colors, a warm terracotta (#C86A4A) and a soft sage green (#A8B89A). Mix them and tell me what color I get.
Check the contrast between text color #333333 and background #F5F0E6. Tell me if it passes WCAG AA for body text and give the ratio.
